During the initial analysis, research will be conducted to determine the actual load on mainnet during peak periods of congestion in the past. This will later be used to simulate this load as closely as possible on the congested testnet.
The high-level design of the testnet will also be completed.
Outputs:
・Report on the distribution of transactions during recent congestion periods.
・Design document.
ms.criteria:
・The report clearly displays the distribution of transaction sizes, number of transactions, and any other relevant metrics such as CPU and memory usage (if available).
・The design document outlines the various components of the congested testnet and how the testnet will operate.

ms.promise:
This phase will consist of creating a testnet that is configured to match the mainnet as closely as possible, as well as any necessary functionality for simulating transactions (in order to create congestion on the testnet).
The testnet will then be made publicly accessible along with any documentation that developers would need in order to utilize the testnet for testing their DApps.
Outputs:
・A publically accessible testnet that replicates congested conditions on mainnet.
・A test-ADA faucet.
・Source code and documentation for utilizing the testnet.
ms.criteria:
The testnet is publicly accessible.
Developers are able to obtain test-ADA from the faucet.
Developers are able to successfully submit transactions on the testnet.
The testnet behaves similar to the mainnet under heavy load, allowing developers to simulate how their DApps behave under such conditions.
Documentation clearly explains how to utilize the testnet.
The core functions of the testnet are covered in a test suite (faucet, simulated congestion, and transaction submission)
ms.report:

Link to social media post announcing the availability of the congested testnet (below).

The testnet is publicly accessible.
・Instructions for accessing are included in the repository README.

Developers are able to obtain test-ADA from the faucet.
・Instructions for obtaining test-ADA are included in the repository README.

Developers are able to successfully submit transactions on the testnet.
・Instructions for submitting transactions are included in the repository README.

The testnet behaves similarly to the mainnet under heavy load, allowing developers to simulate how their DApps behave under such conditions.

EVIDENCE

ms.promise:
The final phase of this project will consist of achieving full decentralization of the testnet (where it will be maintained by the SPO community going forward), as well as providing the necessary closeout report and video. Please note that full decentralization and long-term maintenance ultimately depend on community adoption; like all Project Catalyst projects, this initiative has a finite scope and budget with only so many resources to apply toward that end.
 Outputs:
・A smooth transition and full handover of the congested testnet to the SPO community (contingent upon community interest).
・A public announcement once the testnet is no longer being hosted by MLabs (and is either being hosted by the community in a decentralized fashion or is available to host locally)
・Project closeout report.
・Project closeout video.

Note on Formal Agreements:
We will not have a formal agreement with the SPO community as this was never part of the original proposal or the approved Change Request. Should there be interest in establishing a formal agreement in the future, it would require a separate Catalyst proposal to secure additional resources.
